title: Central Park, south to north
content:
In at Columbus Circle, up the Mall under its elms to Bethesda Terrace and the fountain, across Bow Bridge and on to Belvedere Castle. The park was laid out by Olmsted and Vaux from 1858.

Demo day: the walk is a simulated route along the park's real paths. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
